Perfect! All 161 tests pass, including 16 new tests for the payment terms feature. Here's what I added:

**`src/errors.js`**
- Added `TERMS_INVALID` error code

**`src/invoices.js`**
- Updated `createInvoice()` to accept optional `terms` parameter (defaults to `'NET30'`)
- Validates terms and returns `TERMS_INVALID` for unknown values
- Calculates `dueDate` based on term:
  - `'NET14'`: 14 days after issueDate
  - `'NET30'`: 30 days after issueDate (default)
  - `'EOM'`: last day of issueDate's month (handles year rollovers and leap years)
- Sets `invoice.terms` and `invoice.dueDate` in returned invoice

**`test/invoices.test.js`**
- 16 new tests covering:
  - Default NET30 term
  - All three term types (NET14, NET30, EOM)
  - Invalid terms error
  - Month/year boundary rollovers
  - Leap year handling (Feb 29)
  - End-of-month calculations for all months
  - Field preservation and validation order

The terms system integrates seamlessly with existing invoice functionality, including discounts and VAT calculations.
